# Dataset configuration

## Components

### Config modal

This is the dataset configuration screen. It uses a modal to force the user
through the configuration process after uploading a new dataset. It is used to
configure the odm-version and table-mapping of the dataset, and consists of
pre-populated dropdowns for all settings, together with ok & cancel buttons.

- odm-version dropdown:
    - initialized to detected ODM version
- table mapping dropdowns:
    - initialized to detected ODM tables
- ok button:
    - update dataset properties with selected values
    - go to `/datasets` page (using `href` property)

## Implementation

### Stores

**memory**:
- conf-modal-flag: bool
- selected-dataset-path: str

**local**:
- [datasets](dataset-upload.md#stores)

### Callbacks

The following callbacks assert that a dataset is selected (using
`selected-dataset-path`, either from being in a dataset context (`/datasets`
page), or when coming directly from the dataset upload screen.

**dataset-menu.configure-button.n_clicks**:
- set conf-modal-flag

**conf-modal-flag.data**:
- using selected dataset:
    - set filename text
    - set odm version
    - set table mapping

**conf-modal.ok-button.n_clicks**:
- using selected dataset:
    - set dataset.odm_version
    - set dataset.tables
    - unset conf-modal-flag
